symptom: the datasheet says my sensor INT pin is on physical pin 13 of the header, and my script uses 13, but nothing responds.

files.sense.py:
from gpiozero import Button
irq = Button(13)
irq.wait_for_press()
print("interrupt")

gold.diagnosis: Physical header pin 13 is BCM 27. gpiozero takes BCM numbers: Button(27).
